newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 8.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ivory Coast opens EXPO-96, a window on its economy's drive to become the "Elephant of Africa".
- French and Ivorian business leaders end talks in Abidjan aimed at reinvigorating trade ties between the two countries.
- Expansion of Abidjan international airport expected to cost 15 billion CFA francs.
- Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan outlines government measures to attract foreign investment partners to Ivory Coast in discussion forum held on sidelines of Ivorian trade fair.
- Work on modernisation of Abidjan airport to start in January, management firm says.
- New chief executive for Air Afrique to be appointed on Monday at summit of heads of state of 11-member states owning the African carrier.
